tagline.en:
Exploring what’s next.
Building what’s possible.

summary.zh: 在这里介绍实验室的研究使命。我们关注机器人、自主系统与空间探索，连接基础研究与真实世界的挑战。
summary.en: Introduce your research mission here. Explore robotics, autonomous systems and space exploration, connecting fundamental research with real-world challenges.

body.zh: 用一段简洁的文字介绍你的实验室、研究方法以及希望解决的问题。这里的内容可以在管理后台随时修改。
body.en: Describe your lab, its approach, and the questions you want to answer. All content can be updated in the administration area.

join.zh: 我们期待对研究充满好奇的同学与合作伙伴。请在后台补充招生方向、申请要求、开放职位以及联系邮箱。
join.en: We welcome curious students and collaborators. Add research opportunities, application requirements, open positions and a contact email in the administration area.
